what: pytorch_model.bin of glockr1/ballr7: a PyTorch archive compressed with 7z rather than zip, whose pickle begins with a platform-aware reverse shell to a hardcoded IP address (the report's indicators list 107.173.7.141) and breaks after it, which Picklescan of the time did not detect.

evidence.basis: ReversingLabs lists glockr1/ballr7 among the malicious Hugging Face repositories of the nullifAI campaign (and prints SHA-1 values, which the feed cannot use). The repository is disabled and unchanged since 2023-12-13, before the report, and holds one pickle-bearing file; this is the LFS object id the Hub API lists for it, tied to the listed blob id by the pointer check.

source.title: Malicious ML models discovered on Hugging Face platform
